ops.text: plugins/long-running/lib/sprite/drive (the Sprite drive shim, ~/.local/bin/drive): ask() raises SystemExit whenever orca orchestration ask --wait --json exits nonzero, but orca exits 1 on ask_timeout while printing {"ok":false,"result":{"timedOut":true,...}} on stdout, so main()'s while asked.get("timedOut") resume loop never runs and every drive verb slower than 10 minutes dies with "orca orchestration ask exited 1". Fix: parse stdout JSON in ask() whatever the exit status and resume on timedOut. Hit on drive job set --repro, drive pr add and drive job report from Sprite lane j2415; resumed by hand with orca orchestration ask --resume.
